build.method: One internal bridge bone: translation = mean transformed rest anchor under INDEX_MCP / THUMB_CMC skin transforms; rotation = quaternion slerp(0.5) of those two skin transforms. Converted through unchanged wrist parent into helper local pose.
build.derived_motion_storage: 421 helper-only pose samples in separate NLA Action; original axis-corrected Action remains assigned for original joints. A simple runtime matrix blend can replace this POC bake.

build.choice_reason: Small 3×3×3 volume cage, deterministic control-point drivers, no target binding, no simulation; simpler than Mesh/Surface Deform for this bounded volume-support screen.
build.stack: Existing shape keys -> original LBS Armature -> one local Lattice modifier
build.driver: Outward smooth B-spline volume-support field; activation derives from quaternion difference of existing index MCP and thumb CMC local rotations. Raw differing local frames are a POC limitation; no fitted severity gates.
build.serialization_repair: Detached ZERO original Action explicitly retained, no geometry/rig/design changes

C.implementation_limitations: Coarse deterministic outward field, not a tissue solve. Activation uses differently rolled local quaternions, so it is a weak articulation proxy. POC physical cage covers a larger volume than the vertex mask; only the compact first-web mask affects the hand. No further tuning after failed key gate.
